newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real drops 0.19 pct in speculative trade.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real drops 0.19 pct in speculative trade.

text.p: Brazil's real fell 0.19 percent to close at 1.0295 per greenback in speculative trade on the commercial foreign exchange market, dealers said.
Banks continued speculating over dollar outflows, dealers said. In the last four sessions, net dollar flows registered a total deficit of $171.1 million.
Preliminary figures for commercial and financial foreign exchange contracts showed a Monday deficit of $15 million.

Dealers said they are particullary concerned about the low level of contracted exports during October. So far, contracted exports total $3.050 billion, against $3.810 billion in the same period of September.
In the interbank foreign exchange floating rate market, the real ended at 1.0316 per dollar, down 0.01 percent.
In the illegal parallel market, the real dropped 0.46 percent to close at 1.090 real per greenback.
